simple.meaning: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַיִן (H5869) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 897 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַיִן (ʻayin) means an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 3.

II. עַ֫יִן noun feminine spring (of water) (connection with I. ׳ע dubious; Late Hebrew id. , Phoenician ען ; Assyrian ênu, înu; Arabic ; Ethiopic ; Palmyrene עַיְינָא עֵינָא, ᵑ7 עינא, ; Syriac ); — absolute ׳ע 1Sam 29:1 +, עָ֑יִן Gen 49:22 +, הָעַ֫יְנָה 24:16 , 45 ; construct עֵין 24:13 +; plural עֲיָנֹת Deut 8:7 , וֺת - 2Chr 32:3 ; construct עֵינוֺת Exod 15:27 = Num 33:9 , עִינוֺת Prov 8:28 (Ges § 93v ); — spring Gen 16:7 ; 24:16 , 29 , 30 , 42 , 45 (all J) 49:22 (poem in J), 1Sam 29:1 ; חַמַּיִם עֵין Gen 16:7 ; 24:13 , 43 (J), compare Exod 15:27 (J) Num 33:9 (P); וּתְחֹמֹת ע מַיִם ׳נַחֲלֵי Deut 8:7 ; הָעֲיָנוֺת מֵימֵי 2Chr 32:3 ; ׳ְ תְּהוֺם Prov 8:28 (i.e. of the sea); figurative יַעֲקֹב עֵין Deut 33:28 (poem), i.e. Jacob's descendants. Particular springs are: a. ׳ע חֲרֹד Judg 7:1 (on location compare GFM). b. ׳ע הַקּוֺרֵא ( partridge-spring ) Judg 15:19 (compare id. ). c. ׳ע רֹגֵּל near Jerusalem (early sanctuary RS Sem i. 157, 2nd ed. 172 ) 2Sam 17:17 compare 1Kin 1:2 , on border of Judah Josh 15:7 , and Benjamin 18:16 . d. ׳ע הַתַּנִּין ( dragon-spring ) Neh 2:13 (= c ? so RS l.c .). — On הָעַיִן שַׁעַר 2:14 ; 3:15 ; 12:37 see שַׁעַר [ עַ֫יִן ] noun feminine Ezra 5:5 eye (see Biblical Hebrew I. ׳ע ); — construct עֵין 5:5 (of God); plural (K § 51, 1 ) of horn, עַיְנִין Dan 7:8 , 20 ; of man, dual construct עַיְנֵי 7:8 , suffix עַיְנַי 4:31 .
